resources.string: Reads the official TikTok app\'s screen to audit your Following list and unfollow fake, closed or dead accounts that you have explicitly approved, with conservative pacing and strict daily limits.
Runs inside the official TikTok app via the Accessibility service. Audit mode is read-only; unfollow only ever runs from a list you reviewed and approved yourself.

1) Enable the Accessibility service from the Readiness card above; grant the floating-bubble permission if you want to control the run from inside TikTok without leaving it. 2) Open TikTok, sign in with your account, then start the audit from the Audit tab below — the tool navigates to the Following list and verifies it before collecting any name, and stops if it cannot confirm it. 3) After the audit, review the candidates list yourself and tick the confirmation — unfollow never starts without your review and approval, and runs at conservative pacing (60/day, 12/hour by default) and stops immediately on any verification screen.
Enable “TikTok Following Cleaner” in the installed-services list
The Accessibility service is not enabled. Enable it first in Settings.

A small Messenger-style control bubble shown over TikTok only while a run is active: pause/resume and immediate stop without leaving TikTok. It needs the “draw over other apps” permission — the only permission this app requests. Without it everything works exactly as before, minus the bubble.
not granted — without it the tool works as before, with no bubble
Show the floating bubble during a run
Enable “TikTok Following Cleaner” in the “Display over other apps” list
The “draw over other apps” permission must be granted first, from the button above

Open TikTok → your profile → Following, leave the Following list on screen, then tap Start audit. The tool scrolls the list and collects names, then opens each profile and classifies it: GONE / FAKE / DEAD / UNKNOWN / ACTIVE. Nothing is ever unfollowed in this mode.
Audit: %1$s — %2$s\nCollected from list: %3$d • Classified: %4$d/%5$d\nGONE: %6$d • FAKE: %7$d • DEAD: %8$d • UNKNOWN: %9$d • ACTIVE: %10$d
Audit: saved — %1$d of %2$d classified. Tap Resume audit to continue where it stopped

Pick the candidates file (from the audit, or your own CSV: one username per line), review the list, tick the confirmation, then start. Conservative defaults: 60/day max, 12/hour, random 30–120 s gaps. The tool stops immediately on any CAPTCHA/verification screen or 3 consecutive failures.
I reviewed the candidates list myself and approve unfollowing these accounts
Inactivity thresholds and unfollow pacing — values are saved on your device only.
Note: daily and hourly limits are locked to safe ceilings inside the code and cannot be raised above 150/20 no matter what you type here.
An account with no new video for this many days is classified DEAD. Default: 180
Cap on unfollows in a rolling 24-hour window. Cannot exceed 150. Default: 60
Cap on unfollows in a rolling one-hour window. Cannot exceed 20. Default: 12
Lower bound of the random wait between one unfollow and the next. Default: 30
Upper bound of the random wait between one unfollow and the next. Default: 120
Batch size before a longer break
After each batch the tool takes a longer break (5 minutes or more). Default: 12 (between 10 and 15)
